name: kit-agents
description: A live board of your running subagents: one card each with its name, model, current task, how full its context is and how long it has run. A subagent that is waiting is highlighted with a Reply button that opens its conversation. It sits in a pane beside the chat in a wide terminal, or in a band above the prompt anywhere else, with a /board command and a Vietnamese interface.

showBand.title: Show the board above the prompt
showBand.description: Turn off to hide the band. The pane, the /board command and the buttons in them keep working.

usePane.title: Open the pane in a wide terminal
usePane.description: On: in a wide terminal the board opens by itself in a pane beside the chat while subagents run, and the band steps aside. Closing the pane by hand keeps it closed until the subagents are done. Off: the band is always used. Other surfaces always use the band.

maxCards.title: Most subagents to show
maxCards.description: Whole number from 1 to 12; a value outside that range is cut to it. The rest are counted on a "+N more" line.

language.title: Language of the board and /board
language.description: auto: Vietnamese when Claude Code's own language setting is Vietnamese, English otherwise (looked up once at session start). en: always English. vi: always Vietnamese (Tiếng Việt).
